hub.speaker: Erin
hub.text: Oh good, someone with working legs! I've got a package for Selys at the Guild - mind running it over? Also the common room is a disaster, don't look at it.

text_variants.text: Selys is still waiting on that package, you know.
Back already? The inn feels almost manageable since you sorted that delivery. Almost.
I know what the road is like. I'm not asking you to un-fight anything. I'm asking you to knock first at the idea that they're all the same. Sign stays up.

options.text: Let me deal with that table. ([Basic Cleaning])

options._comment: Finding #26: this used to have no follow-up gate at all, so 'You sent it back!' (and its keep-the-tip twin below) replayed Erin's one-off epilogue reaction every single time the hub was re-entered, forever. reward_acknowledged is a NEW shared flag (gave_reward/kept_reward are mutually exclusive per selys_delivery.json, so one flag safely covers both epilogue options) banked the first time either fires; hide_when retires both for good after that one hearing, same shape as cleaned_the_inn/reported_cleaning just above.

options.text: Delivery's done. I kept the tip.
You never talk about where you're from.

options._comment: stage-3 perk, once per waking. Gate combines the SAME accomplishment stage-gate erin_home uses with the new once_per_waking seam (dialogue.gd's second sanctioned {accomplishment, once_per_waking} compound) -- meal:erin banked by bank_first_use, cleared at sleep(). well_fed:true folds into hp_mod at the next combat build (field HP has no direct target).

(spec §1 beat 1 / §5.4: 'no Erin gate on the chain -- she reacts via existing pool lines, gates nothing'; this OPTION is the beat-1 trigger itself, not a gate on anything downstream) Gated on post_game (the GDI epilogue's own completion marker, banked by sleep_veil.gd once -- 'post-epilogue sleep' per spec §1), so the flicker beat can only start after Act III's own ending. Appended AFTER every existing option (index-safety convention -- this option is hidden pre-post_game for every earlier canonical, so appending here never shifts any prior visible index). Starts the quest AND banks door_chain_started in one option, matching the_errand/missing_crate's own quest-start shape.
options.text: Something wrong with the pantry door?

package.speaker: Erin
package.text: You're a lifesaver! Selys is out the door, past the... goblin situation. She's the Drake who looks like she's already done with your nonsense.

cleaning_directions.speaker: Erin
cleaning_directions.text: Really? It's the horror show by the south wall. I owe you one - or the table does.

cleaned.speaker: Erin
cleaned.text: Whoa. That was - the table's actually reflective now. Skills are so unfair.

epilogue_gave.speaker: Erin
epilogue_gave.text: Selys sent the whole reward back with you? That Drake pretends she's all scales. Free breakfast for a week, I mean it.

epilogue_kept.speaker: Erin
epilogue_kept.text: Good! You earned it - goblins and Drake bureaucracy in one afternoon. Just don't spend it all on Krshia's stall.

erin_chess.speaker: Erin
erin_chess.text: Heard from who? Okay, yes. I play a little. And by a little I mean I will destroy you and feel great about it. It's the one thing I never have to think about. Which is funny, because it's ALL thinking.

erin_chess_two.speaker: Erin
erin_chess_two.text: Deal. Fair warning: Olesm's been practicing for months and I still win. Draw your own conclusions and bring snacks.

options.text: It's a date. The chess kind.

erin_home.speaker: Erin
erin_home.text: Far. Really far. Like, you can't get there by walking, and believe me, I did the math on walking. ...Anyway! The inn's home now. It has a door and everything. Some of the chairs match.

erin_home_two.speaker: Erin
erin_home_two.text: Yeah? I keep deciding that on purpose, so it's nice when it lands by accident. Okay — no more feelings before lunch, house rule.

erin_meal.speaker: Erin
erin_meal.text: Sit. Eat. That's an order, not a suggestion. New recipe — still testing it, but it should stick to your ribs. Call it +2 HP. Don't ask me to explain the math.

erin_door_flicker.speaker: Erin
erin_door_flicker.text: It went somewhere COLD this morning. Doors shouldn't have moods. …Can you look? If it eats you, yell.
